posts.author: office-coordinator
posts.body:
Stamp no. 4 has been missing since Monday. It is city property and not transferable.

If it turns up: put it on the front office desk, no questions asked.

posts.author: clerk-2
posts.body: Stamp no. 4 is the one with the crooked edge. Nobody wanted it.

posts.author: office-head
posts.body:
We called ticket 87 today. Four people were in the room. Three of them held 12, 13 and 14.

Please hand out numbers in order. Not in stacks.

posts.author: clerk-3
posts.body: The machine spits out three tickets at once if you press too hard.

posts.author: office-head
posts.body: Then press gently. A new machine has been requested. Since 1996.
